newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh likely to host mini South Asia summit.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh likely to host mini South Asia summit.

text.p: Bangladesh expects to host a three-nation South Asian summit in Dhaka in November, newspapers on Tuesday quoted Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina as saying.
She said officials were trying to work out plans for the Bangladesh-India-Pakistan summit that Dhaka has proposed to host.

"Prime Minister Nawaz Sharif of Pakistan has accepted my invitation and he is likely to visit Dhaka in November. We also expect Indian premier Inder Kumar Gujral's arrival here in November," the Daily Star quoted Hasina as telling reporters on Monday.
"Chances are there for a three-nation summit," she said without elaborating.
The official BSS news agency also reported on Monday night that a three-nation summit was likely in Dhaka in November, but gave no details.
Hasina met Sharif during the just concluded Developing-8 Islamic summit in Istanbul, where she extended the invitation to the Pakistani leader.
There was no official confirmation as to whether Gujral has been invited yet.
